answer: Disease Diagnosis: Paddy Brown Spot (Bipolaris oryzae). Based on reported symptoms, your paddy crop is affected at Moderate severity.

symptoms_confirmed: Oval brown lesions on leaf blades with grey/whitish centers
Yellow chlorotic halo surrounding leaf spots
Dark brown spots on seed glumes and panicle branches

differential_diagnoses.distinguishing_factor: Blast lesions are spindle-shaped; Brown Spot produces rounded/oval lesions.
Narrow brown spot causes linear streaks parallel to leaf veins, not oval spots.

steps.detail: Apply Azoxystrobin 250 g/L SC (Amistar) at 15 mL per 16 L knapsack sprayer. Observe 14-day Pre-Harvest Interval.
Tebuconazole 250 g/L EC (Folicur) at 15-20 mL per 16 L sprayer. Alternate to prevent resistance.
Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) - 50 g crushed seed per litre. Spray early morning.
Drain standing water for 48 hours to reduce canopy humidity and aerate the root zone.
Apply Muriate of Potash (MOP) at 15 kg/acre to reinforce cell wall resistance.

prevention: Use certified disease-free seed paddy from DOA seed production farms (Bg 352, Bg 358, Bw 367).
Perform hot water seed treatment at 52-54 degrees C for 15 minutes before pre-germination.
Maintain balanced N:P:K fertilization as per DOA agro-ecological zone guidelines.
Adopt optimal planting density (20 cm x 15 cm) to promote air circulation within the canopy.
Apply Trichoderma viride bio-fungicide at root zone during moist soil conditions.
Remove weed hosts (e.g., Echinochloa colona) along field bunds that harbor fungal spores.
Scout fields weekly from tillering stage onwards and act on first symptom appearance.
